white.$description: Pure white: the light page and popover, and color.static.white.

black.$description: Pure black: the base of color.static.black (modal scrims) and of the elevation shadows.

8.$description: White at 8%: dark-mode borders, fills and state veils, which take the hue of the surface under them.

10.$description: White at 10%: dark-mode borders, fills and state veils, which take the hue of the surface under them.

15.$description: White at 15%: dark-mode borders, fills and state veils, which take the hue of the surface under them.

5.$description: The neutral ink (mist.950) at 5%: light-mode state veils, which take the hue of the surface under them.

7.$description: The neutral ink (mist.950) at 7%: light-mode state veils, which take the hue of the surface under them.

base.$description: Base border radius. The derived steps below were resolved from it (ratio recorded in each description) so that Tier 2 stays a pure alias layer.

normal.$description: Normal line height for body text.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed line height for readable text.

loose.$description: Loose line height for spaced-out text.

wider.$description: Wider tracking for all-caps or labels.

mono.$description: Monospace typeface for code and numeric data.

xs.$description: Line height paired with the xs font size (1 / 0.75), rounded up at the fifth decimal: the minified CSS keeps five, and the line then lands on a whole pixel.

sm.$description: Line height paired with the sm font size (1.25 / 0.875), rounded up at the fifth decimal: the minified CSS keeps five, and the line then lands on a whole pixel.

base.$description: Line height paired with the base font size (1.5 / 1).

lg.$description: Line height paired with the lg font size (1.75 / 1.125), rounded up at the fifth decimal: the minified CSS keeps five, and the line then lands on a whole pixel.

xl.$description: Line height paired with the xl font size (1.75 / 1.25).

2xl.$description: Line height paired with the 2xl font size (2 / 1.5), rounded up at the fifth decimal: the minified CSS keeps five, and the line then lands on a whole pixel.

3xl.$description: Line height paired with the 3xl font size (2.25 / 1.875).

4xl.$description: Line height paired with the 4xl font size (2.5 / 2.25), rounded up at the fifth decimal: the minified CSS keeps five, and the line then lands on a whole pixel.

sm.$description: Small elevation for cards and subtle lifts.

md.$description: Medium elevation for dropdowns and popovers.

lg.$description: Large elevation for modals and dialogs.

2xl.$description: Maximum elevation for toasts and high-impact overlays.

instant.$description: Zero duration — immediate state change, not a visual transition.

0-03.$description: 3% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-xl light elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-04.$description: 4% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-xs/sm/md/lg light elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-05.$description: 5% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-inner light elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-07.$description: 7% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-md light elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-08.$description: 8% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-sm/lg/xl light elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-10.$description: 10% opacity. Embedded literally in color.white-alpha.10 today. Reserved for a white-alpha token that would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-12.$description: 12% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-2xl light elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-15.$description: 15% opacity. Embedded literally in color.white-alpha.15 today. Reserved for a white-alpha token that would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-18.$description: 18% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-md dark elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-20.$description: 20% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-xs/sm/lg/xl dark elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-25.$description: 25% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-md dark elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-30.$description: 30% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-sm/lg/inner dark elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-35.$description: 35% opacity. Embedded literally in the shadow-xl dark elevation value today. Reserved for composite shadow tokens, which would reference it instead of embedding the value.

0-50.$description: 50% opacity, used in shadow-2xl dark and disabled states.

dropdown.$description: Raw stacking value for the dropdown layer.

sticky.$description: Raw stacking value for the sticky layer.

fixed.$description: Raw stacking value for the fixed layer.

overlay.$description: Raw stacking value for the overlay layer.

modal.$description: Raw stacking value for the modal layer.

popover.$description: Raw stacking value for the popover layer.

toast.$description: Raw stacking value for the toast layer.

tooltip.$description: Raw stacking value for the tooltip layer.

sm.$description: Viewport min-width of the `sm:` variant. Equal to Tailwind's default, which the build compiles into media queries.

md.$description: Viewport min-width of the `md:` variant. Equal to Tailwind's default, which the build compiles into media queries.

lg.$description: Viewport min-width of the `lg:` variant. Equal to Tailwind's default, which the build compiles into media queries.

xl.$description: Viewport min-width of the `xl:` variant. Equal to Tailwind's default, which the build compiles into media queries.

2xl.$description: Viewport min-width of the `2xl:` variant. Equal to Tailwind's default, which the build compiles into media queries.

1-5.$description: Between hairline and 2px; reads as a solid stroke on small marks.

2.$description: Double hairline; wide enough to read as a gap between overlapping elements.
